source_behavior.summary: SetMediaTab clears the current explorer selection/preview and switches ContentExplorer to the selected site's authoritative WordPress media collection.
source_behavior.side_effect: read-only tab selection; no WordPress mutation

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The Laravel Content Explorer exposes Media only when the server-selected active site and exact tenant/site Media API contract agree, then hands off to the existing canonical Media Explorer with ?site={active_site.id}. No duplicate media subsystem or synthetic media state is introduced.

authorization.security_result: The control grants no authority and is absent unless the existing Media route capability and exact server-issued Media endpoint validate.

runtime_semantics.authoritative_external_state: Existing Media Explorer reads persisted WordPress media state through the tenant/site-scoped Media API.

coverage: exact operation marker and Media label
tenant-qualified canonical Media destination with authoritative site
foreign tenant remains behind server 404 boundary
